Interface EquipmentDesignKernel<I,O>

Type Parameters:
I - immutable or defensively copied calculation input
O - typed calculation output
All Superinterfaces:
EngineeringCalculationModule<I,O>, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
Api12JSeparatorDesignKernel, Api2000TankVentingScreeningKernel, Api521ReliefDesignKernel, Api526OrificeSelectionKernel, Api617CompressorDesignKernel, DnvRpC203FatigueDesignKernel, DnvRpF101CorrodedPipelineScreeningKernel, DnvRpF104Co2PipelineEnvelopeScreeningKernel, DnvRpF105FreeSpanScreeningKernel, DnvRpF109OnBottomStabilityKernel, DnvRpF110GlobalBucklingResponseScreeningKernel, DnvRpF114PipeSoilInteractionScreeningKernel, DnvStF101PipelineDesignKernel, Iso5167OrificeMeteringKernel, NorsokM506CorrosionDesignKernel, PumpApi610DesignKernel
public interface EquipmentDesignKernel<I,O> extends EngineeringCalculationModule<I,O>, Serializable
Pure, typed adapter contract for an equipment design calculation associated with a standard.

Implementations must not mutate the supplied input or a ProcessSystem. Legacy mutable calculators are connected through adapters that copy their configuration before execution.
